items.source: Simple implementation of the BeanDefinitionRegistry interface. Provides registry capabilities only, with no factory capabilities built in. Can for example be used for testing bean definition readers.
items.translation: `BeanDefinitionRegistry` 接口的简单实现。仅提供注册功能，未内置工厂功能。例如，可用于测试 Bean 定义读取器。

items.source: Check if this registry contains a bean definition with the given name.

items.source: Return the names of all beans defined in this registry.
